versions.content: Aggregation possibilities of CpSoftwareClusterToAppli- cationPartitionMapping The CpSoftwareClusterToApplicationParti- tionMapping can be aggregated by CpSoftwareClusterMappingSet and by SystemMapping . • CpSoftwareClusterMappingSet . softwareClusterToApplication- PartitionMapping can be used in an early stage of the Methodology if the System with the RootSwCompositionPrototype and all included SystemMapping s is not available yet. • SystemMapping . softwareClusterToApplicationPartitionMapping can be used in a later stage of Methodology if the System with the RootSwCom- positionPrototype and all included SystemMapping s is available.
